Tickets Strong for Weekend Festival

Construction crews closed two lanes of the bridge for most of the afternoon, causing delays across the city. Officials said the plan would take effect next spring, though several members warned that the timeline could slip again. Work is expected to begin along the waterfront corridor before the end of the year, weather permitting. The library will extend its hours on weeknights beginning next month, funded by a private grant. The city council approved a new budget on Tuesday, setting aside funds for transit, parks and a long-delayed repair program. Analysts described the decision as a compromise that leaves almost everyone partly satisfied and partly frustrated. Ticket sales have been strong, and organizers say they expect a larger crowd than last year. Officials emphasized that no final decision has been made and that additional hearings will be scheduled.
headline: Tickets Strong for Weekend Festival
